name: Voice scenario-testing web app for domain model validation

mentions.name: Voice scenario-testing web app for domain model validation
mentions.description: A web app that lets NGO management test product scenarios by recording voice, with an AI agent built on the Claude Agent SDK running each scenario against the software's domain model. Gaps surfaced this way can be persisted as scenarios, which the builder reads and assimilates into the domain model after every iteration.
mentions.problem: The builder has a day job and cannot spend much time in sync with the NGO team, so the app lets management test scenarios asynchronously and surface gaps in the domain model.
mentions.audience: NGO management, who record and test scenarios through the app.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have created a web app where the NGO management can test scenarios (by recording voice), and the AI (Claude Agent SDK) runs it past the domain model. In case, there is a gap, they can persist the scenario.

evidence.value: I have created a web app where the NGO management can test scenarios (by recording voice), and the AI (Claude Agent SDK) runs it past the domain model. In case, there is a gap, they can persist the scenario.
